description: In crates/core/src/ipld/metadata.rs, the doc comment on compute_byte_count (or the note in compute_metadata) states the field represents body_bytes.len() but the actual computation in compute_metadata passes header_bytes.len() + body_bytes.len() as the byte_count. The doc is wrong. Fix: update the doc comment to accurately describe 'total raw article size (header + body bytes)'.
title: metadata: compute_byte_count doc says body_bytes.len() but adds header length too
